rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it likely overcalls features such as early hatching and confidently assigns A-grade ICM/TE from a single still image.
Integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrium, BMI, alcohol use, and first-cycle status well with embryo prognosis, though some comments on AMH are speculative.
Reasoning is mostly logical and the prognosis estimate follows from the favorable age and morphology, with only minor inconsistencies/speculation around AMH and alcohol interpretation.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice: SET in a young patient with a good Day 5 blastocyst, caution about hydrosalpinx, standard luteal support, and not overusing PGT-A; minor deviations include some overstatement of morphology-based prediction.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, hydrosalpinx review, luteal support, alcohol cessation, and when to consider further workup.
